tools.name: search_clubs
tools.description: Find Compteam clubs by name to get the branch_slug the public tools need. Lists only clubs with a public schedule. Returns club IDs, slugs, names, locality and timezone.

tools.name: list_public_classes
tools.description: Show a club's public class schedule for one week, e.g. to find a free class's occurrence_key. Not for booking or paying for a paid class. Returns occurrence keys, dates, capacity and public actions.

tools.name: list_public_membership_plans
tools.description: Show a club's active membership plans and prices. Information only: never present it as a way to sign up or pay. Returns recurring prices, billing cadence and signup fees.

tools.name: get_public_branch_details
tools.description: Show a club's public profile, address, policies, and booking, landing-page and registration links. Information only: no checkout. Returns address, policies, logos and public action links.

tools.name: connect_compteam_account
tools.description: Start Compteam sign-in. Use when a member, child, RSVP, trial, registration or staff tool needs an account. Returns the verified account, client capabilities and a tool-refresh hint.

tools.name: list_my_subjects
tools.description: List the signed-in member's own profile and linked children with their clubs, to get branch_id and child_id for member tools. Returns subject IDs, club IDs and self/child relationships.

tools.name: list_my_classes
tools.description: Show upcoming classes for the signed-in member or a linked child in one of their clubs. Not for children who are not linked to the account. Returns dates, availability and the subject's current RSVP status.

tools.name: get_account_status
tools.description: Show limited membership and payment status for the signed-in member or a linked child. Not for looking up other members. Returns membership status and counts of open bills, without bank details.

tools.name: set_class_rsvp
tools.description: Confirm or cancel the member's or a linked child's RSVP for one class; this can move the waitlist. Never without the user's confirmation. Returns the authoritative status and any waitlist position.

tools.name: show_free_trial_form
tools.description: Open the free-trial inquiry form for a free, available class. Not for paid classes or classes that are full. Returns the secure form URI and selected class details.

tools.name: submit_free_trial_inquiry
tools.description: Send a free-trial inquiry for a free class after the user confirms the details. Not for paid classes; never resend an inquiry the user already sent. Returns the inquiry intent ID and submission status.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_clubs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
